title: carapa indica
intro: Carapa indica, commonly known as Crabwood or Andiroba, is a large evergreen tree native to the Amazon rainforest. The tree is valued for its oil extracted from its seeds, which has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting against bacterial and fungal infections. The therapeutic actions of Carapa indica oil include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like andiroba oil, carapa glyceride, and other fatty acids. The bioactive constituents present in Carapa indica oil have been found to contribute to its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential benefits.
